title: Lawson homology groups of Chow varieties
summary: Let $C_{p,d}(\mathbb{P}^n)$ denote the Chow variety of effective algebraic $p$-cycles of degree $d$ in complex projective space $\mathbb{P}^n$. In this paper, we compute the rational Lawson homology groups $L_qH_k(C_{p,d}(\mathbb{P}^n))_\mathbb{Q}$ for $0 \leq 2q\leq k \leq 2d$. Additionally, we prove that the rational Lawson homology groups of a natural completion of the Chow monoid of algebraic $p$-cycles in projective spaces are isomorphic to the corresponding rational singular homology groups.
